title: What are the principal risks of world models?
summary: Invalid simulated worlds can create unsafe action, privacy loss, dependency and cyber-physical risk.
body: Key risks include flawed simulations, unsafe deployment, simulation-to-reality failure, pervasive sensing, spatial privacy erosion, liability ambiguity, concentrated control of action-labelled data and simulation infrastructure, strategic dependence, cyber-physical attack and dual-use national-security applications.
